messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT @ 2026-06-21T02:12:01Z - elevated error rate and latency observed on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Affected: subset of Dedicated tenants. Suspected cache layer regression. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/cache-issues
sara: on-call (sara) — I9m looking. paging eng-runtime + eng-sre. grabbing dashboards now.
mike: mike (eng-runtime) — can join. give me ~10m. any quick mitigations? :thinking_face:
sara: quick dashboard snapshot: token p50/p95 up ~3x, 5xx from 0.3% -> 6% in ~8m. prefix-KV cache hit-rate drops 92% -> 11% around 02:05 UTC. suspect invalidation/regeneration storm.
anita: anita (eng-sre) — I9ll collect logs/metrics. which pools to pull from?
sara: focus: red-runtime-prod-gpupool-{a,b,c}. pulling aggregated exporter metrics and logs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot:deploy: Notifying: config push 1763004000 by config-ci — changed `prefix_cache.invalidate_after_secs` 3600 -> 0 for canary (50% traffic). https://redwood/deploys/1763004000
mike: that matches the spike. TTL=0 would cause immediate invalidations, huge churn, KV regen.
ryan: ryan (eng-runtime) — I9m throttling canary traffic and will attempt config rollback. starting mitigation now.
sara: mitigation performed:
```
1) route-canary set traffic=0% -> stable
2) set-config prod prefix_cache.invalidate_after_secs=3600
3) rolling restart cache-shard consumer on gpupool-a
```
Status: route change @ 02:21 UTC, config rollback @ 02:22 UTC, restart started @ 02:24 UTC.
anita: pulling exporter metrics; prometheus queries: `prefix_cache_hitrate{pool="gpupool-a"}`, `prefix_cache_miss_total{pool="gpupool-a"}`. partial: 02:00 hitrate 0.91; 02:05 hitrate 0.11; 02:22 hitrate 0.65; 02:30 hitrate 0.89. recovery after rollback+restart.
mike: can we get `prefix_cache_invalidate_calls` counts?
anita: yes. at 02:06: canary=true -> 98k invalidates; canary=false -> 12. massive skew.
ryan: hypothesis A: config push set TTL=0 on canary -> mass invalidation -> regen pressure -> hit-rate collapse and latency/5xx.
ryan: hypothesis B: recent runtime change (PR #4217) enabled `kv_reuse_async=true` and introduced a race under regen pressure, causing a code path that returns 5xx when queues are saturated.
sara: timeline draft (please verify):
- 02:03 UTC: config push to canary (invalidate_after_secs=0)
- 02:05 UTC: hit-rate collapse + 5xx spike
- 02:21 UTC: routed canary traffic to stable
- 02:22 UTC: rolled config back to 3600s
- 02:24 UTC: restarted cache consumer on gpupool-a
- 02:30 UTC: hit-rate ~baseline, errors dropped
Please add missing items.
anita: logs (gpupool-a replica-3):
```
[02:04:58] ERROR cache: failed to serve prefix pfx-7f3: kv-regen-timeout
[02:05:01] WARN regen: queue length=2048, dropping requests
[02:05:03] ERROR http: upstream 502 svc-runtime
```
mike: I9ll review PR #4217 (merged 1762999000). pinging deploy-bot for PR details.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot:pr: PR #4217 — toggled `kv_reuse_async=true` and added fast inline regen path. https://redwood/pr/4217
ryan: action items (owners):
- anita: export full metrics (invalidate_calls, per-prefix hit-rates, canary flag) -> CSV + plots
- mike: audit PR #4217 for races, reproduce locally under invalidation storm
- sara: customer impact summary + CS notify for affected tenants
- ryan: run controlled canary replay to validate rollback
Please confirm ownership.
anita: confirmed. gathering metrics, will post CSV + hit-rate timeline within 20m.
mike: confirmed. reproducing PR locally with aggressive invalidates.
sara: confirmed. drafting customer notice and marking partial outage for Dedicated tenants. ETA 30m for first notify.
ryan: quick code grep shows `kv_reuse_async` enabled on canary builds deployed last night.
anita: early CSV excerpt:
```
timestamp,pool,canary,prefix_hitrate,invalidates
1763004000,gpupool-a,true,0.92,23
1763004300,gpupool-a,true,0.15,78000
1763004500,gpupool-a,true,0.12,98000
1763004800,gpupool-a,true,0.65,12000
1763005400,gpupool-a,true,0.87,200
```
sara: need per-tenant 5xx counts to prioritize CS outreach.
anita: pulling per-tenant spikes -> tenants t-089, t-112, t-502 show visible 5xx surges. DMing sara and uploading summary here shortly.
mike: repro notes: with `invalidate_after_secs=0` + `kv_reuse_async=true`, regen workers saturated; enqueue path fails and code returns 502 when queue full. local load test reproduces similar 502s when TTL=0.
ryan: validation: rolling back TTL removes invalidation storm; but PR #4217 still risky under heavy regen. plan: revert PR #4217 on canary and rerun heavy invalidation test to confirm regression.
sara: RCA checklist: timeline + graphs (anita), log snippets + stacks (anita/mike), PR analysis + repro (mike), mitigation record + customer impact (sara), follow-ups + owners (ryan). I9ll open incident ticket and a customer status.
anita: uploaded artifacts: https://redwood/incident/1763004321/artifacts.zip. CSV & plots at https://redwood/incident/1763004321/timeline.csv and /hitrate-plot.png
mike: found suspect line in PR: `if (!try_enqueue()) return error(502);` smell of dropping on queue-full. commenting on PR and preparing revert.
sara: handoff: I9m stepping out for 12m. mike primary for triage next 30m; ryan owns mitigation/traffic; anita owns logs/metrics. Post updates here. :white_check_mark:
mike: acknowledged. will open revert PR to canary and run validation harness.
anita: metrics trending back to stable; hit-rate ~0.88 across pools.
ryan: recommendations for permanent fixes: guardrail against TTL=0 on canary unless safety flag, add backpressure instead of immediate 502 on enqueue fail, and add automated canary health checks to block config pushes that cause rapid invalidate spikes.
sara: customer note draft (to be sent after per-tenant counts): "We experienced a transient degradation impacting a subset of Dedicated customers due to an unintended cache invalidation configuration change on a canary group. Traffic was routed off the canary and configuration rolled back; service restored within ~25 minutes. We will provide a detailed RCA with remediation in the incident ticket." :writing_hand:
ops-bot: incident-bot: incident 1763004321 status -> mitigated. Move to RCA channel when ready.
sara: copying thread to incidents channel and starting the RCA doc. last check-in at 02:55 UTC. thanks team. :heart:
mike: final: I9ll open revert PR and include a test harness to simulate invalidation storms. assigned to me, will update RCA ticket.
anita: attaching final logs + exporter snapshots to artifacts.zip.
ryan: will draft follow-up remediations and assign owners in RCA doc.
[END THREAD]
